# Replace the bag

[All care guides](README.md)

![Replace the bag](../img/clean_base--bag.svg)

**What it does**

The bag in the station collects what the robot empties into it. When it is full, the station can no longer empty the robot.

**How to**

1. Open the lid of the station.
2. Pull the bag out by its tab: the tab seals the opening.
3. Insert the new bag and push its card into the guide until it sits.
4. Close the lid and mark the bag as replaced.

> **Note** Do not reuse a bag: its seal closes only once.
